name: Web Form Session Login
description: Logs in to a website through its HTML login form, as a browser would, and outputs the session cookies and every response header, for later HTTP requests that need the session.
introductoryText:
Logs in to a website that uses an HTML login form: loads the login page, fills in the user name and password (keeping hidden fields such as anti-forgery tokens), submits the form and follows the redirects in one session.

**How to set it up**: enter the address of the login page, the user name and the password.

**Outputs**: *Cookies* has the session's cookies (name, value, domain, path, expiry); *Headers* has every response header of every request and redirect, for checking what the site did. Pass the cookies to later HTTP requests (for example as a Cookie header). The outputs hold a live session: treat them like a password.

The block stops with a message when the site answers with an error or still shows a password field after the login; untick *Stop if the login fails* to get the outputs anyway.

options.name: url
options.title: Login page URL
options.description: The address of the page with the login form, such as https://portal.example.com/login.

options.name: username
options.title: User name
options.description: Typed into the form's user name or e-mail field (the block picks the likeliest text field).

options.name: password
options.title: Password
options.description: Typed into the form's password field.

options.name: checkLogin
options.title: Stop if the login fails
options.description: Ticked: stop with a message if the site answers the login with an error status (400 or above) or still shows a password field afterwards. Unticked: always output the headers and cookies, to see what happened.

blockOutputs.label: Headers
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per response header, for every request and redirect: stage, hop, request URL and cookies sent, status, redirect location, header name and value.

blockOutputs.label: Cookies
blockOutputs.tooltip: The session's cookies after the login: name, value, domain, path, Secure, Expires (UTC; empty for session cookies) and other attributes.
